Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Nonkululeko Mlaba to bowl first!
...THE CHASE...

New Zealand Women bowled well but their fielding was touch loose. The Kiwis would have taken the score. Variation is key on this pitch as it is not much doing altough spinning slightly. Right then, this is a must win game for both. A very important chase is coming up. Stay tuned.

Not quiet sure who will be the happier one as both teams have equal chance at the break. South Africa Women opted to bat but kept on losing wickets at regular intervals. If not for the stand of Chloe Tryon and Nadine de Klerk they would have ended up with a low score but the middle order came on handy and scored some crucial runs.
This is a decent score by the hosts. Not a big one but if bowled well, they can pull out a win. New Zealand Women will be happy as well but a better effort on the field would have helped them.
Just one! On middle, Nadine de Klerk pulls it to square leg for a single. South Africa Women end with 132/6.
Full and on middle, slower one. Jafta chips it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Much needed! Too full and too wide. Jafta drives it past cover for four.
Slower ball, outside off, Jafta fails to cut it away.
Dropped! Length ball, outside off. Nadine de Klerk smashes it straight to mid off where the fielder tries to reverse cup it but drops a sitter.
Too full and outside off, punched to mid off.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! End of a good innings by Tryon! This is on a length and around off. Tryon backs away to pull but gets a top edge and it goes to short third man. The keeper, Bernadine Bezuidenhout calls and takes it comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Bernadine Bezuidenhout b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is hit to deep mid-wicket.
Dropped! Full and on off, Nadine de Klerk heaves it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs to her right and takes but fumbles to hold on.
On middle, Tryon helps it to short fine leg for a quick single. Would have been close if the stumps were hit at the batter's end.
Hayley Jensen is feeling her cramps. Pulled up twice from the run-up.
Fuller and outside off, Tryon turns it to deep mid-wicket for two more. Really good running.
On off, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Just one! Tossed up, outside off, swept to deep mid-wicket for one.
Very full again, on off, Nadine de Klerk keeps it out.
Outside off, slapped to cover.
FOUR! Well played! A half-volley, outside off. Nadine de Klerk comes down the track and smashes it past mid off for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, punched to mid off.
This is good running from these two! Full and outside off, Nadine de Klerk sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A yorker around off, Tryon squeezes it out back to the bowler.
Full toss on off, worked to long on for a single.
Outside off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, tucked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Two more! Outside off, Nadine de Klerk dabs it past backward point. Nadine de Klerk wasn't aware of the second but Tryon pushed her.
Length and outside off, Nadine de Klerk slaps it to deep cover for two.
This one nips back in on middle, punched to covers for one.
Length ball, outside off, Tryon works it to long off for one.
Outside off, pushed to covers for one.
Short and outside off, Nadine de Klerk looks to cut but gets an outside edge to the keeper who was standing up. She fails to hold on and instead injures herself.
FOUR! 100 up! A slower ball but Nadine de Klerk reads Kerr's hand pretty well as she stays back and guides it past backward point for four.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Edged again! Outside off. Tryon looks to cut but gets an outside edge and even the keeper gets a hand but just finger-tips. It deflects to the third man fence.
A bumper, angled across the batter. Tryon lets it go.
Goes full and on the pads. Tryon misses her flick. Missed out there.
FOUR! Edgy one but South Africa will take it! Short and on off, Tryon looks to pull but gets a top edge behind the keeper and into the fence.
Length ball, outside off, Nadine de Klerk slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Full and outside off, driven to the right of mid off, excellent stop there.
Tossed up, outside off, punched to deep cover for one.
Tryon again fails to read and fails to hit it away.
FOUR BYES! Misses everything! This is outside off and spins more away. Tryon mises her sweep. The keeper fails to read and it goes behind to the fence.
Outside off, punched to covers for a single.
This one skids on, short and outside off. Nadine de Klerk looks to cut but misses.
Flighted outside off, dragged to long on for one.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and outside off, worked to point for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed to point.

OUT! BOWLED! New Zealand Women strike again! Timely wicket! Tucker played all over it. She first tries to play on the off side but sees the line is not good enough. It is on middle. Tucker tries to scoop but misses and it hits the stumps.
On off, kept out.
Two wides! Pushes it way down leg, the keeper fumbles and a single is taken.
FOUR! Tryon is known for playing this shot! On off, Tryon hammers it down to long off and beats the fielder.
On middle, nudged to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Much needed one! Full and on off, Tryon shuffles across and smokes it down to long on for four.
Darted on the pads, Tryon keeps it out.
Fuller and outside off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed again to mid on.
This one skids on middle, punched to mid on.
four runs off the over! South Africa Women need more! Tossed up, outside off. Tucker looks to reverse sweep but mistimes and the ball ends on the leg side. One.
Angling on the pads, tucked to deep square leg for one.
Almost a yorker on middle, Tryon jams it out.
On a length and on middle, slower and nips in. Tucker looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A muted appeal follows.
Tossed up on middle. Tryon whips it behind square leg for one more.
On middle, kept out.
Full and on off, Tryon chips it to long on for a single.
Flatter and on middle, kept out.

That looked close! New Zealand Women take a review for LBW! A googly, full and on middle. Tryon lunges forward to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. No bat clearly. Is it going down leg? Ball Tracking shows yes it does and goes over the stumps as well.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A full toss, outside off, Tryon drives it past mid off for four runs. Poor ball.
Around off, punched to cover.
Full and outside off, driven to deep cover for one.
This is full and outside off, Tucker steers it to third man for one.
Full and outside off, Tucker knocks it to point.
On middle, blocked out.

OUT! BOWLED! South Africa Women in trouble now! What a delivery from Lea! This is full and around off at 111 clicks. Wolvaardt did not read the slow ball and went for a big swing across but misses and the ball hits the stumps.
Too full and on middle, Wolvaardt jams it out to cover.
That was just tailing down the leg side. On the pads, Wolvaardt misses her flick and gets hit on the pads.
TWO RUNS! Fuller and outside off, Tryon drives it past cover and gets two more.
Outside off, guided to point.
Full and on off, eased to long on for one.
Length and outside off, Wolvaardt keeps it out.
A single as this is pushed to covers.
Length and on off, Wolvaardt works it to long on for one.
FOUR! On middle, Tryon helps it to fine leg for four.
On off,f kept out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bernadine Bezuidenhout you genius! Outside off, Wolvaardt mistimes her flick and gets hit on the pads. There was a misunderstanding for a single and Luss was running at the danger end. The ball rolls to the right of the keeper, Bernadine Bezuidenhout who runs in, dives and underarms it on her side. What a work from her.
Outside off, slower ball. Wolvaardt looks to cut but misses.
On middle, Luus turns it behind square on the leg side for one.
Length ball on off, Wolvaardt plays it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! 12 off the over! 22 off the last two. On middle, this is flicked past mid-wicket for four runs.
THREE LEG BYES! This one goes down the leg side. Wolvaardt misses her sweep and it goes to fine leg where the fielder makes a superb stop.
Outside off, cut to point.
Fuller and on off, bunted to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Luus continues to find boundaries! Around off, Luus whips it through mid-wicket for four runs.
Tossed up, outside off, punched to cover.
Yet another good over for the hosts! 10 off it. On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Outside off, Wolvaardt cuts and pierces it through point for four more.
On a length and on the pads. Luus tickles it to fine leg for one.
On middle,this is nudged to deep square leg for a couple.
Length and on off. Luus prods and drops it to cover.
Full and on middle, pushed to long off for one.
FOUR! Another one! 8 runs off the over! Length ball, outside off. Luus hangs back and slaps it past cover for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
FOUR! Good way to release the pressure! On a length and around off. Luus strokes it past mid on over the fielder for four.
Three dots now! This one swings back in, on off, tucked to square leg.

Edged but just short! Length ball, tailing outside edge. Luus has a poke at it but gets an outside edge and it falls just short of the keeper who catches it. The umpire still wants to take it upstairs. Soft-signal is not out. Yes, it clearly bounced before reaching the keeper's mitt.
Outside off, Luus swings and misses.
Short and outside off, dabbed to third man for one run.
On a length and on top of middle. Defended.
Outside off, guided to point.

OUT! FOUR AND OUT! Kapp tried to force there but goes! Not a good start for the hosts! Short of a length and on middle. Kapp mistimes her pull shot and gets a top edge. High and to backward point where Jess Kerr takes it. A huge roar from Lea Tahuhu follows.
Commentary.Howout: c Jess Kerr b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Wrong line! This is down the leg side. Kapp does not miss out as she flicks past fine leg for four.
Goes very full and on leg, nudged to deep square leg for one more.
This is full and outside off. Kapp punches it straight to cover.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! First of the game! Length ball, outside off. Kapp cuts over point and finds the fence.
Full and on middle. Kapp looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length ball on middle. Blocked out.
Kerr serves a full ball, swinging outside off, Kapp drives it to cover.
Kapp is off the mark! Outside off, dragged to long on for one.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to point.

OUT! LBW! Brits is given out LBW. She has a long chat with Wolvaardt and then opts to review. Looks out to the naked eye. UltraEdge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows THREE REDS. Brits has to go and takes a review with her. What a start for the Kiwis. Flighted full, around off, Brits plays the wrong line as she looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. That looked plumb but South Africa Women have wasted a review now.
Touch short and on middle. Wolvaardt pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, Brits flicks it to mid-wicket for one more. She is off the mark as well.
Tossed up on middle, Wolvaardt punches it to long on for a single.
Done with the proceedings. It is time for action. Eden Carson to start with the ball. Tazmin Brits and Laura Wolvaardt to open for South Africa. Let's play...
Both teams are out for their national anthems. It will be the Kiwis first followed by the hosts.
New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Bernadine Bezuidenhout (WK), Georgia Plimmer, Amelia Kerr, Sophie Devine (C), Maddy Green, Hayley Jensen, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Eden Carson, Fran Jonas.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Tazmin Brits, Laura Wolvaardt, Marizanne Kapp, Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Nadine de Klerk, Delmi Tucker, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Nonkululeko Mlaba.
TOSS - South Africa Women have won the toss and will BAT first.

The hosts South Africa Women began their campaign with a shock defeat against Sri Lanka. New Zealand on the other hand, were thumped by defending champions Australia. Both were quite morale deflating defeats but pretty sure the two teams will be eager to bounce back. Two sides with a lot of quality will be going up against each other. Which team will bag its first win? We will find out.
